title: AgentSandboxPolicy.v1
description: The sandbox-governance contract for an agent run on the shared plane. Deny-by-default boundary: required forces the run to execute inside an isolated sandbox; isolation_level names how strong the isolation is; network_policy gates outbound network (deny-by-default — 'deny' unless explicitly opened); no_host_exec_by_default keeps the agent from executing on the host unless a policy override (with a proof) opens it. The sandbox is the eval/execution substrate; its output is never served truth.

required.description: when true, the run MUST execute inside a sandbox or be treated as unavailable

isolation_level.description: strength of isolation; 'none' is only for an explicitly-approved trusted path

network_policy.description: outbound network policy; deny-by-default ('deny'); 'allowlist' permits only named destinations

no_host_exec_by_default.description: when true, the agent cannot execute on the host unless a policy override with a proof opens it
